description: This file defines a class 'MemoryAdapterReceiver' which implements the 'IQueueAdapterReceiver' interface for memory stream message handling within the Orleans streaming framework. It manages message retrieval, monitoring, and shutdown logic for a memory-based stream adapter.

classes.name: MemoryAdapterReceiver<TSerializer>
classes.description: A generic internal class implementing IQueueAdapterReceiver for handling memory stream messages, with support for monitoring and asynchronous message processing.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the receiver and tracks its startup.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a batch of messages from the memory stream queue, with performance tracking.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Acknowledges message delivery; currently a no-op.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Ensures all pending message retrieval tasks complete before shutting down and tracks the shutdown process.
